nodes.speaker: Maud
nodes.text: I stopped baking the day the last chair stayed empty.

nodes.speaker: Maud
nodes.text: Funny thing. I never lost the recipe. I lost the reason.
[i]She puts her hands into the flour. It is warm. It has been warm the whole time.[/i]

nodes.speaker: Maud
nodes.text: Flour, water, salt, patience... and someone to feed.
[i]She looks across the table at you.[/i]

nodes.speaker: Maud
nodes.text: Sit. You look like you could use a loaf.
